onboarding.welcomeSubtitle: A minute of setup now, and logging takes seconds later.

food.title: Log what you eat
food.body: Quick actions on Today, a food library you build once, and a description you can turn into an entry.

activity.title: Walking and workouts
activity.body: Enter any two of duration, distance and speed. The third one and the energy burned follow.

weight.title: Weigh in when it suits you
weight.body: Every entry feeds the trend on Progress and keeps the estimates honest.

goal.title: A daily calorie target
goal.body: Worked out from your body data and how active you are, and yours to override at any time.

onboarding.bodySubtitle: The calorie target is calculated from these numbers.
onboarding.goalSubtitle: Where you are heading, and how active an ordinary day is.
onboarding.preferencesSubtitle: Language and time zone decide how dates and numbers read.

onboarding.adjustTargetHint: Leave it as it is to keep the recommendation.

onboarding.sexRequired: Choose one so the estimate is right
onboarding.saveFailed: Could not save your answers. Try again in a moment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Body data, calorie goal and preferences.
settings.incompleteProfile: Add your sex, date of birth, height and a weight entry to get a recommended target. Until then the app uses 2,000 kcal.
settings.manualHint: You set this manually. It is never changed automatically.
settings.defaultHint: Currently using the default target until your body data is complete.
settings.goalRange: Enter a target between {min} and {max} kcal
settings.formulaNote: Estimates come from the Mifflin-St Jeor formula and your activity level. They are a starting point, not a medical recommendation.
settings.name: Name
settings.activityLevelHint: Describe habitual movement only. Workouts you log are added on top.
settings.timezoneHint: Decides which calendar day an entry belongs to

settings.showGuideHint: A reminder of what each screen is for.

activityLevels.MODERATE: Moderate, active job or daily movement

provider.baseUrlHint: Any OpenAI compatible endpoint, for example https://api.openai.com/v1
provider.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again and never leaves the server.

provider.checkFailed: The provider could not be reached
provider.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL including https
provider.privacyNote: Dish descriptions you submit are sent to the provider you configure. Nothing else from your diary is sent.
provider.modelsUnavailable: The provider would not list its models; type the id by hand.
provider.visionModelHint: Leave it off and the camera stays hidden.
